assets.label: Firmware
assets.description: Requires the Waldorf microQ operating system: the OS update mq_2_23.mid (about 330 KB), or a 512 KB dump of the microQ's ROM. The loader finds it by content, so the name is free.
assets.hint: The emulator runs the microQ's 68000 and its DSP on its own threads, off the audio thread. One Vavra at a time.

assets.label: Sounds
assets.description: Sound sets: the microQ's own sysex dumps, as Waldorf published them. The factory set is mQ_factory2001.mid (300 sounds in banks A to C), from the microQ OS 2.22 package. Every set added here is a bank in the sound list.
assets.hint: An operating system update carries no sounds: without a set, Vavra has none to choose from.
